# 6.accessibility.md

Source: https://github.com/totominc/vue3-select-component/blob/master/docs/content/2.guide/6.accessibility.md

title: Accessibility
description: WAI-ARIA patterns, keyboard navigation, and screen reader support
  title: Accessibility | Vue 3 Select Component
  description: Follow WAI-ARIA listbox patterns with keyboard navigation and screen reader support. Learn focus management, ARIA attributes, and accessible labeling in Vue 3 Select.
  icon: i-lucide-accessibility

Vue 3 Select Component follows the [WAI-ARIA Combobox Pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/) for assistive technologies. The assembled `Select` and primitives share the same accessibility behavior.

## Overview

Built-in support includes:

- **ARIA attributes** for semantic markup (`combobox`, `listbox`, `option`)
- **Keyboard navigation** for full keyboard-only operation
- **Focus management** with `aria-activedescendant` on the searchable input
- **Screen reader support** with descriptive labels and state attributes

## Searchable vs non-searchable

The active control depends on `searchable`:

| Mode | Control element | ARIA owner |
|------|-----------------|------------|
| `searchable` (assembled default) | `SelectInput` (`role="combobox"`) | Input owns the listbox relationship |
| `searchable={false}` | `SelectTrigger` (`<button>`) | Button owns the listbox relationship |

In searchable mode, `SelectTrigger` is a layout wrapper (`<div>`). The input is the combobox. In non-searchable mode, the trigger button opens the menu and carries `aria-expanded`, `aria-haspopup`, and `aria-controls`.

Both APIs use the same primitives underneath. Pass label attributes to the control that is actually focusable.

## ARIA attributes

### Searchable combobox (`SelectInput`)

When `searchable` is enabled, the search input is the combobox control:

```html
<input
  role="combobox"
  aria-autocomplete="list"
  aria-haspopup="listbox"
  aria-expanded="true|false"
  aria-controls="v1-select-1-listbox"
  aria-activedescendant="select-option-3"
  autocomplete="off"
/>
```

| Attribute | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `aria-expanded` | Menu open (`true`) or closed (`false`) |
| `aria-haspopup="listbox"` | Signals a listbox popup |
| `aria-controls` | References the listbox element ID |
| `aria-activedescendant` | Points to the keyboard-focused option (only while open) |
| `aria-autocomplete="list"` | Suggestions appear in the listbox |

### Non-searchable trigger (`SelectTrigger`)

When search is disabled, the trigger renders as a `<button>`:

```html
<button
  type="button"
  aria-expanded="true|false"
  aria-haspopup="listbox"
  aria-controls="v1-select-1-listbox"
>
```

The button is disabled with the native `disabled` attribute. `SelectInput` is not rendered in this mode.

### Listbox (`SelectListbox`)

```html
<div
  role="listbox"
  aria-labelledby="v1-select-1-input"
  aria-multiselectable="true|false"
  tabindex="-1"
>
```

| Attribute | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `aria-labelledby` | References the input ID in searchable mode, or the trigger ID otherwise |
| `aria-multiselectable` | `true` when `multiple` is enabled |

### Options (`SelectOption`)

Each option renders as:

```html
<div
  role="option"
  aria-selected="true|false"
  aria-disabled="true|false"
  data-active="true|false"
>
```

| Attribute | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `aria-selected` | Whether the option is in the current selection |
| `aria-disabled` | Whether the option cannot be selected |
| `data-active` | Keyboard highlight state (style with `[data-active="true"]`) |

Disabled options are skipped during keyboard navigation.

### Popover panel (`SelectPopover`)

The dropdown panel exposes visibility to assistive technologies:

```html
<div data-select-popover aria-hidden="true|false" hidden>
```

When the menu is closed, the panel is hidden and marked `aria-hidden="true"`. Auto-focus on open is prevented so focus stays on the input or trigger.

### Interactive controls

| Element | Accessible name |
|---------|-----------------|
| Clear button (`SelectClear`) | `aria-label="Clear selection"` |
| Tag remove button (`SelectTag`) | `aria-label="Remove"` |
| Leading / trailing icons | `aria-hidden="true"` (decorative) |
| Empty state (`SelectNoOptions`) | `role="status"` |

Customize tag remove labels in the `tag-remove` slot if you need option-specific text. See [Slots](/api/slots).

## Label your select

Associate the select with a visible label using standard HTML attributes. On the assembled `Select`, `id`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`, and `aria-required` are forwarded to the active control (`SelectInput` or `SelectTrigger`).

### Assembled Select

```vue [App.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import Select from "vue3-select-component"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const country = ref<string | null>(null)

const countries = [
  { label: "France", value: "FR" },
  { label: "Germany", value: "DE" },
]
</script>

<template>
  <label id="country-label" for="country-select">Country</label>
  <Select
    id="country-select"
    v-model="country"
    :options="countries"
    aria-labelledby="country-label"
    aria-required="true"
    placeholder="Select a country"
  />
</template>
```

Add helper or error text with `aria-describedby`:

```vue [App.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import Select from "vue3-select-component"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const country = ref<string | null>(null)
const hasError = ref(false)

const countries = [
  { label: "France", value: "FR" },
  { label: "Germany", value: "DE" },
]
</script>

<template>
  <label id="country-label" for="country-select">Country</label>
  <p id="country-helper">Pick the country where you live.</p>
  <Select
    id="country-select"
    v-model="country"
    :options="countries"
    aria-labelledby="country-label"
    aria-describedby="country-helper"
    :aria-invalid="hasError"
    placeholder="Select a country"
  />
</template>
```

### Primitives

Pass the same attributes to the focusable primitive:

```vue [CustomSelect.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import {
  SelectInput,
  SelectListbox,
  SelectNoOptions,
  SelectOption,
  SelectPopover,
  SelectRoot,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "vue3-select-component/primitives"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const model = ref<string | null>(null)

const options = [
  { label: "JavaScript", value: "js" },
  { label: "TypeScript", value: "ts" },
]
</script>

<template>
  <label id="language-label" for="language-select">Language</label>

  <div data-assembled-select>
    <SelectRoot v-model="model" :options="options" searchable>
      <SelectTrigger>
        <SelectValue placeholder="Pick a language" />
        <SelectInput
          id="language-select"
          aria-labelledby="language-label"
        />
      </SelectTrigger>

      <SelectPopover>
        <SelectListbox>
          <SelectNoOptions />
          <SelectOption
            v-for="opt in options"
            :key="opt.value"
            :value="opt.value"
            :label="opt.label"
          />
        </SelectListbox>
      </SelectPopover>
    </SelectRoot>
  </div>
</template>
```

When `searchable` is disabled, pass label attributes to `SelectTrigger` instead of `SelectInput`.

## Keyboard navigation

Keyboard handling is shared between assembled `Select` and primitives.

### When the menu is closed

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `ArrowDown` / `ArrowUp` | Open the menu and highlight the first enabled option |
| `Space` | Open the menu (trigger only, when search text is empty) |
| `Enter` | Open the menu on a focused non-searchable trigger button (native button behavior) |
| `Tab` | Move focus to the next focusable element |

In searchable mode, focusing or clicking the input also opens the menu.

### When the menu is open

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `ArrowDown` | Move to the next enabled option (wraps to the first) |
| `ArrowUp` | Move to the previous enabled option (wraps to the last) |
| `Enter` | Select the active option |
| `Space` | Select the active option when search text is empty and focus is not in the search input |
| `Escape` | Close the menu without selecting |
| `Tab` | Close the menu and move focus |
| `Backspace` | Remove the last selected tag when search is empty (multi-select only) |

Single-select closes the menu after selection by default. Multi-select keeps it open so users can pick multiple values. Override with `closeOnSelect`.

### Search behavior

When `searchable` is enabled:

- Typing filters options in real time
- The active option syncs to the first matching result
- Arrow keys move within the filtered list
- The `@search` event fires as the query changes

## Focus management

When the menu opens, the first enabled option becomes active. In searchable mode, focus stays on the input while `aria-activedescendant` points at the highlighted option.

Disabled options are skipped:

```vue [App.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import Select from "vue3-select-component"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const selected = ref<string | null>(null)
</script>

<template>
  <Select
    v-model="selected"
    :options="[
      { label: 'Available', value: '1' },
      { label: 'Unavailable', value: '2', disabled: true },
    ]"
    placeholder="Pick an option"
  />
</template>
```

### Visual focus indicator

Keyboard-highlighted options use `data-active="true"`. Default assembled styles map this to a focus background. Customize with CSS variables:

```css
:root {
  --vs-option-focused-background-color: #dbeafe;
  --vs-option-focused-text-color: #18181b;
}
```

See [Styling](/guide/styling) for the full variable list and headless `data-*` hooks.

## Dismiss behavior

- Click outside the select closes the menu
- `Tab` away closes an open menu
- `Escape` closes without selecting

## Screen reader support

Assistive technologies can observe:

- Menu open/close via `aria-expanded` on the control and `aria-hidden` on the popover
- The listbox name via `aria-labelledby`
- The active option via `aria-activedescendant` while navigating
- Selection state via `aria-selected` on each option
- Disabled state via `aria-disabled`
- Empty results via `role="status"` on `SelectNoOptions`

Selected values render as visible text in `SelectValue` (single label or multi-select tags). Add `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` on the control when the visible label alone is not enough.

## Unique IDs

Each select instance generates stable IDs for ARIA wiring:

```html
<!-- Searchable -->
<input id="v1-select-1-input" role="combobox" aria-controls="v1-select-1-listbox">
<div id="v1-select-1-listbox" role="listbox" aria-labelledby="v1-select-1-input">

<!-- Non-searchable -->
<button id="v1-select-1-trigger" aria-controls="v1-select-1-listbox">
<div id="v1-select-1-listbox" role="listbox" aria-labelledby="v1-select-1-trigger">
```

Option elements receive unique IDs for `aria-activedescendant`. Pass a custom `id` to `SelectInput` when you need a predictable input ID for `for`/`aria-labelledby` wiring.

## Test with assistive technology

Verify these scenarios during development:

1. Open and close the menu with keyboard only
2. Navigate options with arrow keys and select with Enter
3. Confirm screen readers announce expanded/collapsed state
4. Verify disabled options are skipped
5. In multi-select, confirm tags are visible and removable
6. Repeat in both searchable and non-searchable modes
7. Repeat with assembled `Select` and a custom primitives layout

## Resources

- [WAI-ARIA Combobox Pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/)
- [WAI-ARIA Listbox Pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/listbox/)
- [ARIA Authoring Practices Guide](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/)

# 7.migration.md

Source: https://github.com/totominc/vue3-select-component/blob/master/docs/content/2.guide/7.migration.md

title: Migration
description: Upgrade from v0 to the v1 dual-API design
  title: v0 to v1 Migration | Vue 3 Select Component
  description: Upgrade from v0 to the v1 dual-API design. Review breaking prop and event changes, map old APIs to assembled Select or primitives, and follow the migration checklist.
  icon: i-lucide-arrow-right-left

Still on v0? Read the [v0 documentation](https://v0-vue3-select-component.vercel.app/) for the previous API.

v1 is a breaking release. It adds primitives alongside the assembled `Select`. This guide covers the main changes from v0.

## Understand the new architecture

| v0 | v1 |
|----|-----|
| Single monolithic component | Assembled `Select` + primitives |
| Bundled CSS (`--vs-*` variables) | Optional default styles + headless primitives |
| Slots on `VueSelect` | Slots on individual primitives |
| `Option<T>` type | `SelectOptionData<T>` type |

The assembled `Select` covers common use cases with v1 prop names only. v0 prop aliases are **not** supported, rename them during migration.

## Rename boolean props

v1 uses clearer boolean prop names. Update every usage in your templates and script setup:

| v0 prop | v1 prop |
|---------|---------|
| `isMulti` | `multiple` |
| `isSearchable` | `searchable` |
| `isClearable` | `clearable` |
| `isDisabled` | `disabled` |
| `isLoading` | `loading` |

```vue
<!-- v0 -->
<Select :is-multi="true" :is-searchable="true" />

<!-- v1 -->
<Select multiple />
```

Primitives accept v1 names only. Assembled `Select` is searchable by default, so keep `searchable` only when you need to pass a dynamic value.

## Update imports

```ts
// v0
import VueSelect from "vue3-select-component"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

// v1
import Select from "vue3-select-component"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

// Primitives (new)
import { SelectRoot, SelectTrigger } from "vue3-select-component/primitives"
```

## Update bundled CSS

Keep `import "vue3-select-component/styles"` for the assembled `Select`. Default styles still expose `--vs-*` variables and target `data-*` hooks instead of v0 class names.

For custom primitive compositions, skip the stylesheet and style via `data-*` selectors. See [Styling](/guide/styling).

## Map slots to primitives

v0 slots on the monolithic component map to primitive slots:

| v0 slot | v1 equivalent |
|---------|---------------|
| `#option` | `SelectOption` default slot |
| `#value` | `SelectValue` default slot |
| `#tag` | `SelectTag` default + `remove` slots |
| `#tag-content` | `SelectTag` default slot |
| `#loading` | `SelectTrailingIcon` default slot (`loading` prop) |

The assembled `Select` exposes `icon`, `trailing-icon`, `tag-remove`, `no-options`, `create-item`, and `clear` slots. Enable the clear button with `clearable`. Use primitives for broader customization.

## Event payload differences

On **assembled `Select`**, events still emit source option objects (v0 behavior):

```vue
<Select @option-selected="(option) => console.log(option)" />
```

On **`SelectRoot` primitives**, events emit raw values:

```vue
<SelectRoot @option-selected="(value) => console.log(value)" />
```

Event names use camelCase in script (`@optionSelected`) and kebab-case in templates (`@option-selected`).

## Removed v0 features

These v0 props are not part of v1 yet. Use primitives to implement equivalent behavior:

| v0 prop | v1 approach |
|---------|-------------|
| `displayedOptions` | Filter `options` yourself or use custom `filterBy` |
| `isTaggable` | Handle creation in your app and add options dynamically |
| `isMenuOpen` | Control open state via primitives or custom composition |
| `hideSelectedOptions` | Use `hideSelected` on assembled `Select` or `SelectRoot` |
| `aria` prop | Apply ARIA attributes on primitive elements directly |

## Update TypeScript imports

```ts
// v0
import type { Option } from "vue3-select-component"

// v1
import type { SelectOptionData, SelectModelValue } from "vue3-select-component"
```

---

# 8.examples.md

Source: https://github.com/totominc/vue3-select-component/blob/master/docs/content/2.guide/8.examples.md

title: Examples
description: Interactive demos for assembled Select and headless primitives
  title: Examples | Vue 3 Select Component
  description: Browse interactive demos for the assembled Select and headless primitives. Try single and multi-select, clearable mode, disabled options, loading states, and custom slots.
  icon: i-lucide-gallery-horizontal-end

Live examples for common setups. Each demo prints the current `v-model` value below the control.

## Assembled select

The default export wires up primitives with sensible defaults. Use these patterns when the built-in UX is enough.

### Clearable

Show a clear button when a value is selected.

::client-only
:example-clearable-demo

#fallback
:select-demo-fallback

```vue [App.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import Select from "vue3-select-component"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const selected = ref<string | null>("FR")

const options = [
  { label: "France", value: "FR" },
  { label: "Spain", value: "ES" },
  { label: "United Kingdom", value: "GB" },
  { label: "Germany", value: "DE" },
  { label: "Italy", value: "IT" },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Select
    v-model="selected"
    clearable
    :options="options"
    placeholder="Select a country"
  />
</template>
```

### Non-searchable

Turn off the search input for a button-only select.

::client-only
:example-non-searchable-demo

#fallback
:select-demo-fallback

```vue [App.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import Select from "vue3-select-component"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const selected = ref<string | null>(null)

const options = [
  { label: "Option #1", value: "option_1" },
  { label: "Option #2", value: "option_2" },
  { label: "Option #3", value: "option_3" },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Select
    v-model="selected"
    :searchable="false"
    :options="options"
    placeholder="Select an option"
  />
</template>
```

### Disabled

Disable the entire control when the field should not be editable.

```vue [App.vue]
    v-model="selected"

```

### Loading

Expose a loading state on the trigger while options are fetched.

::client-only
:example-loading-demo

#fallback
:select-demo-fallback

```vue [App.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import Select from "vue3-select-component"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const selected = ref<string | null>(null)
const isLoading = ref(true)

const options = [
  { label: "France", value: "FR" },
  { label: "Spain", value: "ES" },
  { label: "Germany", value: "DE" },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Select
    v-model="selected"
    :loading="isLoading"
    :options="options"
    placeholder="Select a country"
  />
</template>
```

### Hide selected options

In multi-select mode, remove picked options from the dropdown while keeping them as tags in the trigger.

::client-only
:example-hide-selected-demo

#fallback
:select-demo-fallback

```vue [App.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import Select from "vue3-select-component"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const selected = ref<string[]>(["js"])

const options = [
  { label: "JavaScript", value: "js" },
  { label: "TypeScript", value: "ts" },
  { label: "Python", value: "py" },
  { label: "Rust", value: "rs" },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Select
    v-model="selected"
    multiple
    hide-selected
    :options="options"
    placeholder="Select languages"
  />
</template>
```

### Disabled options

Mark individual options as disabled so they cannot be selected.

::client-only
:example-disabled-options-demo

#fallback
:select-demo-fallback

```vue [App.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import Select from "vue3-select-component"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const selected = ref<string | null>(null)
</script>

<template>
  <Select
    v-model="selected"
    :options="[
      { label: 'France', value: 'FR' },
      { label: 'Spain', value: 'ES', disabled: true },
      { label: 'Germany', value: 'DE' },
    ]"
    placeholder="Select a country"
  />
</template>
```

### Close on select

By default, the menu stays open in multi-select mode. Set `close-on-select` to dismiss it after each pick.

::client-only
:example-close-on-select-demo

#fallback
:select-demo-fallback

```vue [App.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import Select from "vue3-select-component"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const selected = ref<string[]>([])

const options = [
  { label: "JavaScript", value: "js" },
  { label: "TypeScript", value: "ts" },
  { label: "Python", value: "py" },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Select
    v-model="selected"
    multiple
    close-on-select
    :options="options"
    placeholder="Select languages"
  />
</template>
```

## Primitives

Compose `SelectRoot`, `SelectTrigger`, `SelectPopover`, and the rest when you need custom layout, slots, or popover behavior. Demos use `data-assembled-select` on a wrapper so default styles apply while you own the DOM tree.

### Full composition

Wire every trigger and listbox primitive yourself. Add a leading icon, search input, clear button, and a custom trailing icon.

::client-only
:example-primitive-composed-demo

#fallback
:select-demo-fallback

```vue [CustomSelect.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import {
  SelectClear,
  SelectIcon,
  SelectInput,
  SelectListbox,
  SelectNoOptions,
  SelectOption,
  SelectPopover,
  SelectRoot,
  SelectTrailingIcon,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "vue3-select-component/primitives"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const selected = ref<string | null>(null)

const options = [
  { label: "France", value: "FR" },
  { label: "Spain", value: "ES" },
  { label: "Germany", value: "DE" },
]
</script>

<template>
  <div data-assembled-select>
    <SelectRoot
      v-model="selected"
      searchable
      clearable
    >
      <SelectTrigger>
        <SelectIcon aria-hidden="true">
          <!-- globe icon -->
        </SelectIcon>
        <SelectValue placeholder="Select a country" />
        <SelectInput />
        <SelectTrailingIcon>
          <template #default="{ open }">
            <span aria-hidden="true">{{ open ? "▲" : "▼" }}</span>
          </template>
        </SelectTrailingIcon>
        <SelectClear />
      </SelectTrigger>

      <SelectPopover>
        <SelectListbox>
          <SelectNoOptions />
          <SelectOption
            v-for="option in options"
            :key="option.value"
            :value="option.value"
            :label="option.label"
          />
        </SelectListbox>
      </SelectPopover>
    </SelectRoot>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Rich option rows

Render two-line options with declarative `SelectOption` children and a custom default slot.

::client-only
:example-primitive-rich-options-demo

#fallback
:select-demo-fallback

```vue [CustomSelect.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import {
  SelectInput,
  SelectListbox,
  SelectNoOptions,
  SelectOption,
  SelectPopover,
  SelectRoot,
  SelectTrailingIcon,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "vue3-select-component/primitives"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

type LanguageOption = {
  label: string
  value: string
  description: string
}

const selected = ref<string | null>(null)

const options: LanguageOption[] = [
  { label: "JavaScript", value: "js", description: "Runs in browsers and Node.js" },
  { label: "TypeScript", value: "ts", description: "Typed superset of JavaScript" },
  { label: "Python", value: "py", description: "General-purpose scripting" },
  { label: "Rust", value: "rs", description: "Systems programming with ownership" },
]
</script>

<template>
  <div data-assembled-select>
    <SelectRoot v-model="selected" searchable>
      <SelectTrigger>
        <SelectValue placeholder="Pick a language" />
        <SelectInput />
        <SelectTrailingIcon />
      </SelectTrigger>

      <SelectPopover>
        <SelectListbox>
          <SelectNoOptions />
          <SelectOption
            v-for="option in options"
            :key="option.value"
            :value="option.value"
            :label="option.label"
          >
            <span class="option">
              <strong>{{ option.label }}</strong>
              <span>{{ option.description }}</span>
            </span>
          </SelectOption>
        </SelectListbox>
      </SelectPopover>
    </SelectRoot>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Grouped options

::note
You do not need group primitives for a flat list. Render `SelectOption` children directly inside `SelectListbox`.

::client-only
:example-primitive-groups-demo

#fallback
:select-demo-fallback

```vue [CustomSelect.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import {
  SelectGroup,
  SelectGroupLabel,
  SelectInput,
  SelectListbox,
  SelectOption,
  SelectPopover,
  SelectRoot,
  SelectTrailingIcon,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "vue3-select-component/primitives"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const selected = ref<string | null>(null)

const frontendOptions = [
  { label: "Vue", value: "vue" },
  { label: "React", value: "react" },
  { label: "Svelte", value: "svelte" },
]

const backendOptions = [
  { label: "Node.js", value: "node" },
  { label: "Go", value: "go" },
  { label: "Rust", value: "rust" },
]
</script>

<template>
  <div data-assembled-select>
    <SelectRoot v-model="selected" searchable>
      <SelectTrigger>
        <SelectValue placeholder="Pick a technology" />
        <SelectInput />
        <SelectTrailingIcon />
      </SelectTrigger>

      <SelectPopover>
        <SelectListbox>
          <SelectGroup>
            <SelectGroupLabel>Frontend</SelectGroupLabel>
            <SelectOption
              v-for="option in frontendOptions"
              :key="option.value"
              v-bind="option"
            />
          </SelectGroup>

          <SelectGroup>
            <SelectGroupLabel>Backend</SelectGroupLabel>
            <SelectOption
              v-for="option in backendOptions"
              :key="option.value"
              v-bind="option"
            />
          </SelectGroup>
        </SelectListbox>
      </SelectPopover>
    </SelectRoot>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Group separators

::note
You do not need group primitives for a flat list. Render `SelectOption` children directly inside `SelectListbox`.

Add `SelectSeparator` between sections when grouped options need a stronger visual break.

```vue [CustomSelect.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import {
  SelectGroup,
  SelectGroupLabel,
  SelectListbox,
  SelectOption,
  SelectPopover,
  SelectRoot,
  SelectSeparator,
  SelectTrailingIcon,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "vue3-select-component/primitives"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const selected = ref<string | null>(null)

const frequentOptions = [
  { label: "France", value: "FR" },
  { label: "Japan", value: "JP" },
]

const otherOptions = [
  { label: "Brazil", value: "BR" },
  { label: "Canada", value: "CA" },
]
</script>

<template>
  <div data-assembled-select>
    <SelectRoot v-model="selected" :searchable="false">
      <SelectTrigger>
        <SelectValue placeholder="Pick a country" />
        <SelectTrailingIcon />
      </SelectTrigger>

      <SelectPopover>
        <SelectListbox>
          <SelectGroup>
            <SelectGroupLabel>Frequent</SelectGroupLabel>
            <SelectOption
              v-for="option in frequentOptions"
              :key="option.value"
              v-bind="option"
            />
          </SelectGroup>

          <SelectSeparator />

          <SelectGroup>
            <SelectGroupLabel>Other countries</SelectGroupLabel>
            <SelectOption
              v-for="option in otherOptions"
              :key="option.value"
              v-bind="option"
            />
          </SelectGroup>
        </SelectListbox>
      </SelectPopover>
    </SelectRoot>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Create item

Let users add a value from the search query. Handle `@create` to push into your options list and update `v-model`.

::client-only
:example-primitive-create-item-demo

#fallback
:select-demo-fallback

```vue [CustomSelect.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import {
  SelectCreateItem,
  SelectInput,
  SelectListbox,
  SelectNoOptions,
  SelectOption,
  SelectPopover,
  SelectRoot,
  SelectTrailingIcon,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "vue3-select-component/primitives"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const statuses = ref(["Backlog", "Todo", "In Progress", "Done"])
const selected = ref("Backlog")

function onCreate(item: string) {
  statuses.value.push(item)
  selected.value = item
}
</script>

<template>
  <div data-assembled-select>
    <SelectRoot
      v-model="selected"
      searchable
      create-item
      @create="onCreate"
    >
      <SelectTrigger>
        <SelectValue placeholder="Pick or create a status" />
        <SelectInput />
        <SelectTrailingIcon />
      </SelectTrigger>

      <SelectPopover>
        <SelectListbox>
          <SelectNoOptions />
          <SelectOption
            v-for="status in statuses"
            :key="status"
            :value="status"
            :label="status"
          />
          <SelectCreateItem>
            <template #default="{ searchValue }">
              Add "{{ searchValue }}"
            </template>
          </SelectCreateItem>
        </SelectListbox>
      </SelectPopover>
    </SelectRoot>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Filter by extra fields

Pass a custom `filterBy` to `SelectRoot` and render extra metadata in each `SelectOption` slot.

::client-only
:example-primitive-region-filter-demo

#fallback
:select-demo-fallback

```vue [CustomSelect.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import {
  SelectInput,
  SelectListbox,
  SelectNoOptions,
  SelectOption,
  SelectPopover,
  SelectRoot,
  SelectTrailingIcon,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "vue3-select-component/primitives"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

type CountryRecord = {
  name: string
  code: string
  region: string
}

const selected = ref<string | null>(null)

const countries: CountryRecord[] = [
  { name: "France", code: "FR", region: "Europe" },
  { name: "Japan", code: "JP", region: "Asia" },
  { name: "Brazil", code: "BR", region: "South America" },
  { name: "Canada", code: "CA", region: "North America" },
]

function filterByRegion(
  option: { label: string; value: string },
  search: string,
) {
  const query = search.trim().toLowerCase()

  if (!query) {
    return true
  }

  const record = countries.find((entry) => entry.code === option.value)

  return option.label.toLowerCase().includes(query)
    || record?.region.toLowerCase().includes(query) === true
}
</script>

<template>
  <div data-assembled-select>
    <SelectRoot
      v-model="selected"
      searchable
      :filter-by="filterByRegion"
    >
      <SelectTrigger>
        <SelectValue placeholder="Search by country or region" />
        <SelectInput />
        <SelectTrailingIcon />
      </SelectTrigger>

      <SelectPopover>
        <SelectListbox>
          <SelectNoOptions />
          <SelectOption
            v-for="country in countries"
            :key="country.code"
            :value="country.code"
            :label="country.name"
          >
            <span>{{ country.name }}</span>
            <span>{{ country.region }}</span>
          </SelectOption>
        </SelectListbox>
      </SelectPopover>
    </SelectRoot>
  </div>
</template>
```

```vue [CustomSelect.vue]
  { label: "Option #1", value: "option_1" },
  { label: "Option #2", value: "option_2" },
  { label: "Option #3", value: "option_3" },
```

# 9.deep-dive.md

Source: https://github.com/totominc/vue3-select-component/blob/master/docs/content/2.guide/9.deep-dive.md

title: Deep Dive
description: How the assembled Select composes primitives, normalizes options, and shares state
  title: Architecture Deep Dive | Vue 3 Select Component
  description: Understand how the assembled Select composes primitives, normalizes options, and shares reactive state. Read the architecture before building custom select experiences.
  icon: i-lucide-layers

The assembled `Select` is not a separate implementation. It is a fixed composition of primitives with extra glue for common app data shapes, events, and form attributes.

If you already use `Select` in your app, this page shows what happens under the hood and where to customize when defaults are not enough.

## Same tree as primitives

Assembled `Select` renders the same primitive tree described in [Primitives](/guide/primitives). `SelectRoot` owns state. Child primitives read it through context.

```
Select (assembled)
└── SelectRoot
    ├── SelectTrigger
    │   ├── SelectIcon (optional slot)
    │   ├── SelectValue
    │   ├── SelectInput (when searchable)
    │   ├── SelectTrailingIcon
    │   └── SelectClear (when clearable)
    └── SelectPopover
        └── SelectListbox
            ├── SelectNoOptions
            ├── SelectOption (×N, from options prop)
            └── SelectCreateItem (when createItem is set)
```

The assembled component wires every slot and prop to the matching primitive. See [Slots](/api/slots) for the mapping.

## What SelectRoot provides

`SelectRoot` is the only place that holds select state. It runs two composables:

| Layer | Role |
|-------|------|
| `useSelectCollection` | Merges options from the `options` prop and declarative `SelectOption` children |
| `useSelectState` | Owns `v-model`, open state, search, filtering, keyboard navigation, and selection |

The result is injected as `SelectContext`. Every primitive calls `injectSelectContext()` to read or update shared state. Primitives outside `SelectRoot` throw at runtime.

Relevant context fields:

- **Selection**: `modelValue`, `select`, `deselect`, `clear`
- **Menu**: `isOpen`, `open`, `close`, `toggle`
- **Search**: `searchValue`, `filteredOptions`
- **Keyboard**: `activeOptionValue`, `moveActiveOption`, `handleKeydown`
- **DOM refs**: `registerTriggerElement`, `registerInputElement`, and IDs for ARIA wiring

Assembled `Select` passes behavior props (`multiple`, `searchable`, `filterBy`, and the rest) straight to `SelectRoot`. It does not reimplement any of this logic.

## Assembled layer glue

### Option normalization

Your `options` prop can use any shape when you pass `getOptionValue` and `getOptionLabel`. Assembled `Select` normalizes them to `{ label, value, disabled? }[]` before passing them to `SelectRoot`.

It also renders one `SelectOption` per normalized entry. That keeps keyboard navigation, filtering, and ARIA in sync with what you passed in.

### filterBy adapter

On primitives, `filterBy` receives a registered option and the search string. On assembled `Select`, `filterBy` receives your **source** option object, its label, and the search string.

The adapter maps values back to source objects so custom filters work with your data model without touching `SelectRoot`.

### Event payloads

`SelectRoot` emits raw values on `@option-selected` and `@option-deselected`. Assembled `Select` looks up the matching source object and re-emits it as `@option-selected` / `@option-deselected`.

This matches v0 behavior and keeps TypeScript tied to your option type.

### Attribute forwarding

Assembled `Select` sets `inheritAttrs: false` and splits fallthrough attributes:

| Attribute group | Searchable (`true`, default) | Non-searchable |
|-----------------|------------------------------|----------------|
| `id`, `name`, `form`, `required`, `aria-*` | `SelectInput` | `SelectTrigger` |
| Everything else | `SelectRoot` | `SelectRoot` |

The focusable control owns labelling attributes. See [Accessibility](/guide/accessibility#label-your-select) for examples.

### Popover props

Props that belong to positioning and teleport (`teleport`, `side`, `align`, and other [reka-ui Popover](https://reka-ui.com/docs/components/popover) options) are stripped from root props and forwarded to `SelectPopover`.

Search and filtering follow the same path. Typing updates `searchValue` in context. `filteredOptions` recomputes. `SelectListbox` only shows options that pass the filter.

## Defaults

These are assembled-only conveniences. Primitives do not implement them.

| Feature | Assembled default | Primitive equivalent |
|---------|-------------------|----------------------|
| Search | `searchable: true` | Add `SelectInput`, pass `searchable` to `SelectRoot` |
| Options list | `v-for` over normalized options | Render `SelectOption` yourself or rely on `options` prop |
| Empty state | `SelectNoOptions` wired | Add `SelectNoOptions` in your listbox |
| Clear button | `clearable` prop + `SelectClear` | Render `SelectClear` when needed |
| Create option | `createItem` prop + `SelectCreateItem` | Add `SelectCreateItem` manually |
| Styles | `data-assembled-select` + import `styles` | Use `data-select-*` hooks on each primitive |

## When to drop to primitives

Stay on assembled `Select` when the default trigger, listbox, and popover layout fit your product.

Reach for primitives when you need to:

- Change DOM structure (infinite scroll, virtual lists, custom groups)
- Own open state or popover rendering
- Emit raw values instead of source objects
- Skip option normalization and register options only via children

Start from the [Primitives](/guide/primitives) guide or the [examples](/guide/examples#primitives) page. Copy the assembled tree and replace the pieces you need.

## Related reading

- [Primitives](/guide/primitives) for the component tree and option registration
- [Usage](/getting-started/usage) for day-to-day assembled `Select` setup
- [Components reference](/api/components) for per-primitive props and DOM hooks
- [Styling](/guide/styling) for `data-assembled-select` and CSS variables

---

# 1.props.md

Source: https://github.com/totominc/vue3-select-component/blob/master/docs/content/3.api/1.props.md

title: Props
description: Props for the assembled Select and SelectRoot primitives
  title: Props API | Vue 3 Select Component
  description: Complete props reference for the assembled Select and SelectRoot primitives. Defaults, types, and behavior for searchable, clearable, multi-select, and popover options.
  icon: i-lucide-settings-2

## Assembled Select

The default export from `vue3-select-component`.

::note
v0 boolean prop names (`isMulti`, `isSearchable`, etc.) are not supported. Rename them to v1 names when upgrading. See the [migration guide](/guide/migration).

### v-model

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `string \| number \| null` (single) or `(string \| number)[]` (multi) |
| **Required** | No |
| **Default** | `null` (single) / `[]` (multi) |

The selected value(s). Type must match `option.value`. See [TypeScript](/guide/typescript).

### options

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `GenericOption[]` |
| **Required** | Yes |

List of options. Each option needs `label` and `value` unless custom mappers are provided.

```ts
type SelectOptionData<Value extends string | number> = {
  label: string
  value: Value
  disabled?: boolean
}
```

### placeholder

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `string` |
| **Default** | `undefined` |

Text shown when no option is selected. Passed to `SelectValue`.

### multiple

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `boolean` |
| **Default** | `false` |

Allow multiple selections. `v-model` must be an array.

### closeOnSelect

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `boolean \| null` |
| **Default** | `null` |

Control whether the menu closes after a selection. When `null` (default), the menu closes on single-select and stays open on multi-select. Set to `true` or `false` to override.

### resetSearchOnBlur

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `boolean` |
| **Default** | `true` |

Clear the search input when the menu closes (blur or dismiss). Set to `false` to keep the query when reopening the menu.

### resetSearchOnSelect

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `boolean` |
| **Default** | `true` |

Clear the search input after an option is selected. Set to `false` to keep filtering while picking multiple values.

### hideSelected

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `boolean` |
| **Default** | `false` |

When `multiple` is enabled, remove already-selected options from the dropdown list. Selected values remain as tags in the trigger. Has no effect in single-select mode.

```vue [App.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import Select from "vue3-select-component"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const selected = ref<string[]>(["js"])

const options = [
  { label: "JavaScript", value: "js" },
  { label: "TypeScript", value: "ts" },
  { label: "Vue", value: "vue" },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Select
    v-model="selected"
    multiple
    hide-selected
    :options="options"
    placeholder="Select languages"
  />
</template>
```

### searchable

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `boolean` |
| **Default** | `true` |

Show a search input in the trigger to filter options. Set `:searchable="false"` to disable it.

### clearable

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `boolean` |
| **Default** | `false` |

Show a clear button when a value is selected.

### disabled

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `boolean` |
| **Default** | `false` |

Disable all interaction.

### loading

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `boolean` |
| **Default** | `false` |

Expose loading state to `SelectTrailingIcon` via `data-loading`.

### Popover props

The assembled `Select` forwards [reka-ui](https://reka-ui.com/docs/components/popover) popover props to the internal `SelectPopover`. Use them to control placement, collision behavior, modality, and teleport deferral.

| Prop | Type | Default | Maps to |
|------|------|---------|---------|
| `teleport` | `boolean \| string \| HTMLElement` | `true` | `PopoverPortal` (`to` / `disabled`) |
| `defer` | `boolean` | `undefined` | `PopoverPortal` |
| `modal` | `boolean` | `undefined` | `PopoverRoot` |
| `side` | `'top' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'left'` | `'bottom'` | `PopoverContent` |
| `sideOffset` | `number` | `4` | `PopoverContent` |
| `sideFlip` | `boolean` | `undefined` | `PopoverContent` |
| `align` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'` | `'start'` | `PopoverContent` |
| `alignOffset` | `number` | `undefined` | `PopoverContent` |
| `alignFlip` | `boolean` | `undefined` | `PopoverContent` |
| `avoidCollisions` | `boolean` | `true` | `PopoverContent` |
| `collisionBoundary` | `Element \| null \| Element[]` | `undefined` | `PopoverContent` |
| `collisionPadding` | `number \| Partial<Record<Side, number>>` | `undefined` | `PopoverContent` |
| `arrowPadding` | `number` | `undefined` | `PopoverContent` |
| `hideShiftedArrow` | `boolean` | `undefined` | `PopoverContent` |
| `sticky` | `'partial' \| 'always'` | `undefined` | `PopoverContent` |
| `hideWhenDetached` | `boolean` | `undefined` | `PopoverContent` |
| `positionStrategy` | `'absolute' \| 'fixed'` | `undefined` | `PopoverContent` |
| `updatePositionStrategy` | `'optimized' \| 'always'` | `undefined` | `PopoverContent` |
| `disableUpdateOnLayoutShift` | `boolean` | `undefined` | `PopoverContent` |
| `prioritizePosition` | `boolean` | `undefined` | `PopoverContent` |
| `disableOutsidePointerEvents` | `boolean` | `undefined` | `PopoverContent` |

`teleport` controls where the panel is rendered. `true` (default) teleports to `body`. A string is a CSS selector target. An `HTMLElement` teleports to that element. Set to `false` to render inline.

`open`, anchor `reference`, and `forceMount` are managed internally and are not exposed.

```vue [App.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import Select from "vue3-select-component"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const value = ref<string | null>(null)

const options = [
  { label: "Option #1", value: "option_1" },
  { label: "Option #2", value: "option_2" },
  { label: "Option #3", value: "option_3" },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Select
    v-model="value"
    :options="options"
    side="top"
    :side-offset="8"
    align="end"
    placeholder="Open to inspect placement"
  />
</template>
```

### getOptionLabel

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `(option: GenericOption) => string` |
| **Default** | `option => option.label` |

Extract the display label from a custom option shape.

### getOptionValue

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `(option: GenericOption) => string \| number` |
| **Default** | `option => option.value` |

Extract the value from a custom option shape.

### filterBy

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `(option, label, search) => boolean` |
| **Default** | Case-insensitive label substring match |

Custom filter for searchable mode. Receives the **source** option object.

### createItem

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `boolean \| "always"` |
| **Default** | `undefined` |

Allow users to create a custom value from the current search query. Requires `searchable="true"`.

Listen to `@create` and update your options and `v-model`.

- `true`: show the create action only when filtering leaves no matches.
- `"always"`: show the create action whenever the search query is non-empty, even if options still match.

```vue [App.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import Select from "vue3-select-component"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const value = ref<string | null>(null)
const items = ref<{ label: string; value: string }[]>([])

function onCreate(query: string) {
  const newItem = { label: query, value: query }
  items.value.push(newItem)
  value.value = newItem.value
}
</script>

<template>
  <Select
    v-model="value"
    :create-item="true"
    :options="items"
    placeholder="Type to create an item"
    @create="onCreate"
  />
</template>
```

## SelectRoot

Props for the primitive root component (`vue3-select-component/primitives`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `v-model` | `SelectModelValue<Value>` | `null` | Selected value(s) |
| `options` | `SelectOptionData<Value>[]` | `[]` | Normalized options array |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Multi-select mode |
| `searchable` | `boolean` | `false` | Enable trigger search input |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | `false` | Show clear button |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable interaction |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Loading state |
| `closeOnSelect` | `boolean \| null` | `null` | Close menu after selection (`null` = auto) |
| `resetSearchOnBlur` | `boolean` | `true` | Clear search when the menu closes |
| `resetSearchOnSelect` | `boolean` | `true` | Clear search after an option is selected |
| `hideSelected` | `boolean` | `false` | Hide selected options from the list in multi-select |
| `createItem` | `boolean \| "always"` | `undefined` | Allow creating a value from the search query |
| `filterBy` | `FilterByFn<Value>` | Label substring | Custom filter on registered options |

## Primitive props

### SelectValue

| Prop | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `placeholder` | `string` | |

### SelectOption

| Prop | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `value` | `string \| number` | **required** |
| `label` | `string` | **required** |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |

### SelectTag

| Prop | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `value` | `string \| number` | **required** |
| `label` | `string` | **required** |

### SelectPopover

`SelectPopover` forwards [reka-ui](https://reka-ui.com/docs/components/popover) `PopoverRoot`, `PopoverPortal`, and `PopoverContent` props. See the assembled [Popover props](#popover-props) table for the full list.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `teleport` | `boolean \| string \| HTMLElement` | `true` |
| `side` | `'top' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'left'` | `'bottom'` |
| `align` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'` | `'start'` |
| `sideOffset` | `number` | `4` |
| `avoidCollisions` | `boolean` | `true` |

All other supported popover props from the table above are also available on `SelectPopover`. Content emits (`escapeKeyDown`, `pointerDownOutside`, `focusOutside`, `interactOutside`, `openAutoFocus`, `closeAutoFocus`) can be listened to on `SelectPopover`.

`SelectTrigger`, `SelectListbox`, `SelectClear`, `SelectCreateItem`, `SelectIcon`, `SelectTrailingIcon`, and `SelectNoOptions` accept no props. `SelectInput` accepts optional `id` and `placeholder` props.

---

# 2.events.md

Source: https://github.com/totominc/vue3-select-component/blob/master/docs/content/3.api/2.events.md

title: Events
description: Events emitted by Select and SelectRoot
  title: Events API | Vue 3 Select Component
  description: Events emitted by Select and SelectRoot. Learn when update:modelValue, open-change, search, and primitive lifecycle events fire during user interaction.
  icon: i-lucide-zap

## Assembled Select events

### optionSelected

Emitted when an option is selected, in the same tick as the `v-model` update.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Payload** | `GenericOption`, the **source** option object |

```vue
<Select
  v-model="selected"
  :options="options"
  @option-selected="(option) => console.log(option.label, option.value)"
/>
```

::tip
For tracking the current selection, prefer a `computed` derived from `v-model` over listening to this event:

```ts
const selectedOption = computed(() =>
  options.find((o) => o.value === selected.value),
)
```

### optionDeselected

Emitted when an option is deselected.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Payload** | `GenericOption \| null` |

`null` is emitted when clearing all values in multi-select mode.

```vue
<Select
  v-model="selected"
  :options="options"
  @option-deselected="(option) => console.log(option)"
/>
```

::note
Pressing **Backspace** to remove the last tag in multi-select updates `v-model` but does **not** emit `optionDeselected`.

### search

Emitted when the search value changes in searchable mode.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Payload** | `string` |

```vue
<Select
  v-model="selected"
  :options="options"
  @search="(query) => fetchRemoteOptions(query)"
/>
```

### menuOpened

Emitted when the dropdown menu opens.

```vue
<Select @menu-opened="onMenuOpened" />
```

### menuClosed

Emitted when the dropdown menu closes.

```vue
<Select @menu-closed="onMenuClosed" />
```

### create

Emitted when the user chooses to create a new item from the search query. Requires `create-item`. The component does not update `options` or `v-model` for you. Handle the event and update your data.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Payload** | `string`, the trimmed search query |

```vue [App.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import Select from "vue3-select-component"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const items = ref(["Backlog", "Todo", "Done"])
const value = ref("Backlog")

function onCreate(item: string) {
  items.value.push(item)
  value.value = item
}
</script>

<template>
  <Select
    v-model="value"
    create-item
    :options="items"
    :get-option-label="(item) => item"
    :get-option-value="(item) => item"
    placeholder="Pick or create a status"
    @create="onCreate"
  />
</template>
```

## SelectRoot events

Primitive root emits the same lifecycle events with different selection payloads:

| Event | Payload | Notes |
|-------|---------|-------|
| `update:modelValue` | `SelectModelValue<Value>` | Use with `v-model` |
| `optionSelected` | `OptionValue` | Raw value, not source object |
| `optionDeselected` | `OptionValue \| null` | `null` on multi clear-all |
| `search` | `string` | Search text changed |
| `create` | `string` | Create-item action chosen |
| `menuOpened` | | Menu opened |
| `menuClosed` | | Menu closed |

```vue [CustomSelect.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import {
  SelectListbox,
  SelectNoOptions,
  SelectOption,
  SelectPopover,
  SelectRoot,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "vue3-select-component/primitives"
import "vue3-select-component/styles"

const model = ref<string | null>(null)

const options = [
  { label: "JavaScript", value: "js" },
  { label: "TypeScript", value: "ts" },
]

function onOptionSelected(value: string) {
  console.log(value)
}
</script>

<template>
  <div data-assembled-select>
    <SelectRoot
      v-model="model"
      :options="options"
      @option-selected="onOptionSelected"
    >
      <SelectTrigger>
        <SelectValue placeholder="Pick a language" />
      </SelectTrigger>

      <SelectPopover>
        <SelectListbox>
          <SelectNoOptions />
          <SelectOption
            v-for="option in options"
            :key="option.value"
            :value="option.value"
            :label="option.label"
          />
        </SelectListbox>
      </SelectPopover>
    </SelectRoot>
  </div>
</template>
```

---

# 3.slots.md

Source: https://github.com/totominc/vue3-select-component/blob/master/docs/content/3.api/3.slots.md

title: Slots
description: Customization slots on primitive components
  title: Slots API | Vue 3 Select Component
  description: Customize Vue 3 Select with primitive slots. Replace trigger content, option rendering, empty states, indicators, and tags without reimplementing select logic.
  icon: i-lucide-layout-template

::info
The assembled `Select` exposes `icon`, `trailing-icon`, `tag-remove`, `no-options`, `create-item`, and `clear` slots. Enable the clear button with the `clearable` prop. For broader customization, compose with [primitives](/guide/primitives).

Primitives expose slots for flexible rendering. `SelectRoot`, `SelectTrigger`, `SelectPopover`, and `SelectListbox` also accept a `default` slot for structural composition.

## Assembled Select

The assembled `Select` forwards customization slots to the underlying primitives.

**`tag-remove`**: remove button content for each tag in multi-select mode.

**Slot props:** `SelectTagRemoveSlotProps`

```ts
{ label: string; value: string | number }
```

```vue
<Select v-model="selected" multiple :options="options">
  <template #tag-remove="{ label }">
    <UIcon name="i-lucide-x" :aria-label="`Remove ${label}`" />
  </template>
</Select>
```

**`no-options`**: empty state when search or filtering removes every option.

**Slot props:** `SelectSearchValueSlotProps`

```vue
<Select v-model="selected" :options="options">
  <template #no-options="{ searchValue }">
    No results for "{{ searchValue }}"
  </template>
</Select>
```

**`create-item`**: create action shown when `create-item` is enabled. Receives the trimmed search query.

**Slot props:** `SelectSearchValueSlotProps`

```vue
<Select v-model="value" create-item :options="items" @create="onCreate">
  <template #create-item="{ searchValue }">
    Add "{{ searchValue }}"
  </template>
</Select>
```

**`clear`**: clear button content. Requires `clearable`.

```vue
<Select v-model="selected" clearable :options="options">
  <template #clear>
    Reset
  </template>
</Select>
```

**`icon`**: leading icon before the placeholder or selected value.

```vue
<Select v-model="selected" :options="options" placeholder="Select a country">
  <template #icon>
    <UIcon name="i-lucide-globe" />
  </template>
</Select>
```

**`trailing-icon`**: trailing dropdown icon. Receives open and loading state.

**Slot props:** `SelectTrailingIconSlotProps`

```ts
{ open: boolean; loading: boolean }
```

```vue
<Select v-model="selected" :options="options">
  <template #trailing-icon="{ open, loading }">
    <span v-if="loading">⏳</span>
    <span v-else-if="open">▲</span>
    <span v-else>▼</span>
  </template>
</Select>
```

## Primitives

### SelectValue

Customize how the selected value is displayed.

**Slot props:** `SelectValueDefaultSlotProps<OptionValue>`

```ts
{
  selectedOptions: readonly {
    id: string
    value: OptionValue
    label: string
    disabled: boolean
  }[]
}
```

```vue
<SelectValue placeholder="Pick one">
  <template #default="{ selectedOptions }">
    <span v-if="selectedOptions[0]">
      ✓ {{ selectedOptions[0].label }}
    </span>
    <span v-else class="placeholder">Pick one</span>
  </template>
</SelectValue>
```

Default behavior: single mode shows the first label or placeholder. Multi mode renders `SelectTag` per selection.

**Named slot `tag-remove`:** remove button content for each tag in multi-select mode. Forwards to `SelectTag`'s `remove` slot.

```vue
<SelectValue placeholder="Pick languages">
  <template #tag-remove="{ label }">
    Remove {{ label }}
  </template>
</SelectValue>
```

### SelectOption

Customize option content in the listbox.

```vue
<SelectOption :value="opt.value" :label="opt.label">
  <strong>{{ opt.label }}</strong>
  <span class="text-muted">{{ opt.description }}</span>
</SelectOption>
```

**Named slot `checkmark`:** icon shown on the right when the option is selected in multi-select mode. Only rendered when `multiple` is enabled and the option is selected.

```vue
<SelectOption :value="opt.value" :label="opt.label">
  <template #checkmark>
    <UIcon name="i-lucide-check" />
  </template>
</SelectOption>
```

### SelectGroup and SelectGroupLabel

::note
You do not need group primitives for a flat list. Render `SelectOption` children directly inside `SelectListbox`.

```vue
<SelectGroup>
  <SelectGroupLabel>Frontend</SelectGroupLabel>
  <SelectOption value="vue" label="Vue" />
  <SelectOption value="react" label="React" />
</SelectGroup>
```

Both components use a plain `default` slot. `SelectGroupLabel` must be inside `SelectGroup`.

### SelectSeparator

Insert a non-interactive divider between groups or sections.

```vue
<SelectGroup>
  <SelectGroupLabel>Europe</SelectGroupLabel>
  <SelectOption value="FR" label="France" />
  <SelectOption value="DE" label="Germany" />
  <SelectOption value="IT" label="Italy" />
</SelectGroup>

<SelectSeparator />
```

### SelectTag

Customize multi-value tags. Used by `SelectValue` in multi-select mode.

**Default slot props:** `SelectTagRemoveSlotProps`

```ts
{ label: string; value: string | number }
```

**Named slot `remove`:** content for the remove button (default: × icon). Uses the same `SelectTagRemoveSlotProps` shape.

```vue
<SelectTag :value="opt.value" :label="opt.label">
  <template #default="{ label }">
    <span class="tag-label">{{ label }}</span>
  </template>
  <template #remove>
    ×
  </template>
</SelectTag>
```

The remove button calls `context.deselect(value)` and has `aria-label="Remove"`.

### SelectIcon

Leading icon before the value display. Place inside `SelectTrigger`, before `SelectValue`.

```vue
<SelectTrigger>
  <SelectIcon>
    <UIcon name="i-lucide-globe" />
  </SelectIcon>
  <SelectValue placeholder="Pick one" />
  <SelectTrailingIcon />
</SelectTrigger>
```

Rendered with `data-select-icon` and `aria-hidden="true"`.

### SelectTrailingIcon

Trailing dropdown icon for open and loading state.

**Slot props:** `SelectTrailingIconSlotProps`

```ts
{ open: boolean; loading: boolean }
```

```vue
<SelectTrailingIcon>
  <template #default="{ open, loading }">
    <span v-if="loading">⏳</span>
    <span v-else-if="open">▲</span>
    <span v-else>▼</span>
  </template>
</SelectTrailingIcon>
```

Exposed via `data-open` and `data-loading` attributes for CSS-only styling.

### SelectCreateItem

Customize the create action when `create-item` is enabled on `SelectRoot`.

**Slot props:** `SelectSearchValueSlotProps`

```ts
{ searchValue: string }
```

```vue
<SelectRoot v-model="model" create-item searchable :options="options" @create="onCreate">
  <SelectPopover>
    <SelectListbox>
      <SelectOption v-for="option in options" :key="option.value" v-bind="option" />
      <SelectCreateItem>
        <template #default="{ searchValue }">
          Create "{{ searchValue }}"
        </template>
      </SelectCreateItem>
    </SelectListbox>
  </SelectPopover>
</SelectRoot>
```

Default text: `Create "{searchValue}"`. Renders with `role="option"` when visible.

### SelectNoOptions

Customize the empty state when no options match the search filter.

**Slot props:** `SelectSearchValueSlotProps`

```ts
{ searchValue: string }
```

```vue
<SelectNoOptions>
  <template #default="{ searchValue }">
    No languages found for "{{ searchValue }}".
  </template>
</SelectNoOptions>
```

Default text: `"No options"`. Renders with `role="status"` when `filteredOptions` is empty.

### SelectClear

Customize the clear button content. Place inside `SelectTrigger` and enable with `clearable` on `SelectRoot`.

```vue
<SelectRoot v-model="model" clearable :options="options">
  <SelectTrigger>
    <SelectValue placeholder="Pick one" />
    <SelectClear>Reset</SelectClear>
  </SelectTrigger>
</SelectRoot>
```

Visible only when `clearable` is enabled, a value exists, and the select is not disabled. Has `data-select-clear` and `aria-label="Clear selection"`.

### SelectTrigger, SelectInput, SelectListbox, SelectPopover

These accept a `default` slot for child composition but do not expose scoped slot props.

```vue
<SelectTrigger>
  <SelectIcon>
    <UIcon name="i-lucide-globe" />
  </SelectIcon>
  <SelectValue placeholder="Choose" />
  <SelectTrailingIcon />
</SelectTrigger>
```

## TypeScript

Slot names and scoped prop types are exported from `vue3-select-component` for wrappers and custom compositions.

**Assembled `Select`:**

```ts
import type { AssembledSelectSlots } from "vue3-select-component"
```

**Primitives:**

```ts
import type {
  SelectClearSlots,
  SelectCreateItemSlots,
  SelectDefaultSlots,
  SelectGroupLabelSlots,
  SelectGroupSlots,
  SelectIconSlots,
  SelectNoOptionsSlots,
  SelectOptionSlots,
  SelectSeparatorSlots,
  SelectTagSlots,
  SelectTrailingIconSlots,
  SelectValueSlots,
} from "vue3-select-component"
```

**Reusable slot prop types:**

```ts
import type {
  SelectSearchValueSlotProps,
  SelectTagRemoveSlotProps,
  SelectTrailingIconSlotProps,
  SelectValueDefaultSlotProps,
} from "vue3-select-component"
```

`SelectValueSlots` and `SelectValueDefaultSlotProps` accept an optional `OptionValue` generic. `tag-remove` slot props use `value: string | number` so forwarded slots type-check across generic components.

See [TypeScript](/guide/typescript) for props, emits, and model value types.

---

# 4.components.md

Source: https://github.com/totominc/vue3-select-component/blob/master/docs/content/3.api/4.components.md

title: Components
description: Reference for all primitive components
  title: Components API | Vue 3 Select Component
  description: API reference for every primitive component in Vue 3 Select. SelectRoot, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectOption, SelectValue, tags, clear button, and more.
  icon: i-lucide-component

All primitives are exported from `vue3-select-component/primitives` and must be used inside `SelectRoot`.

## SelectRoot

State provider and context source. Manages `v-model`, open state, search, filtering, keyboard navigation, and option registration.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Props** | See [Props](/api/props#selectroot) |
| **Emits** | See [Events](/api/events#selectroot-events) |
| **Slots** | `default`, trigger and popover composition |
| **DOM** | `data-select-root` |

## SelectTrigger

The interactive trigger area that toggles the menu. It renders as a button when not searchable and as a layout wrapper when searchable.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Props** | None |
| **Slots** | `default`, typically `SelectIcon`, `SelectValue`, `SelectInput`, `SelectTrailingIcon`, `SelectClear` |
| **DOM** | `data-select-trigger` |
| **ARIA** | Button mode: `aria-expanded`, `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-controls`. Searchable mode: layout only; combobox ARIA belongs to `SelectInput` |

## SelectValue

Displays the current selection or placeholder.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Props** | `placeholder?: string` |
| **Slots** | `default`, `{ selectedOptions }`, `tag-remove`, `{ label, value }` |
| **DOM** | `data-select-value`, `data-empty` |

## SelectInput

Search input rendered when `searchable` is enabled. In the assembled layout it lives inside `SelectTrigger`.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Props** | `id?: string`, `placeholder?: string` |
| **DOM** | `data-select-input` |
| **ARIA** | `role="combobox"`, `aria-autocomplete="list"`, `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-activedescendant` |
| **Notes** | `autocomplete="off"`, bound to context search value |

## SelectPopover

Dropdown panel container built on reka-ui `Popover`. Supports teleporting and forwards reka-ui popover props for placement, collision handling, and modality. See [Popover props](/api/props#popover-props).

| | |
|---|---|
| **Props** | `teleport`, `side`, `align`, `sideOffset`, `modal`, `defer`, and other [reka-ui `PopoverContent` props](/api/props#popover-props) |
| **Emits** | `escapeKeyDown`, `pointerDownOutside`, `focusOutside`, `interactOutside`, `openAutoFocus`, `closeAutoFocus` |
| **Slots** | `default`, usually `SelectListbox` |
| **DOM** | `data-select-popover` |
| **ARIA** | `aria-hidden` when closed |

## SelectListbox

Container for options with `role="listbox"`.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Props** | None |
| **Slots** | `default`, `SelectOption` and `SelectNoOptions` |
| **DOM** | `data-select-listbox` |
| **ARIA** | `role="listbox"`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-multiselectable`, `tabindex="-1"` |

## SelectOption

A single selectable option. Registers with context on mount.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Props** | `value`, `label`, `disabled?` |
| **Slots** | `default`, `checkmark` |
| **DOM** | `data-select-option`, `data-select-option-label`, `data-select-option-checkmark`, `data-value`, `data-active` |
| **ARIA** | `role="option"`, `aria-selected`, `aria-disabled` |

Hidden when filtered out by search or when `hideSelected` removes selected values in multi-select. In multi-select mode, selected options show a default checkmark icon on the right (overridable via the `checkmark` slot). Click calls `context.select(value)`.

## SelectGroup

Use when options need labelled sections. For a flat list, render `SelectOption` directly inside `SelectListbox`.

Structural wrapper for related options. It is not selectable and does not register in the option collection.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Props** | None |
| **Slots** | `default`, usually `SelectGroupLabel` and `SelectOption` |
| **DOM** | `data-select-group` |
| **ARIA** | `role="group"`, `aria-labelledby` when a label is present |

The group hides when filtering removes all of its child options.

## SelectGroupLabel

Label for a `SelectGroup`.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Props** | None |
| **Slots** | `default` |
| **DOM** | `data-select-group-label` |

Must be rendered inside `SelectGroup`.

## SelectSeparator

Optional. Use with grouped lists when you need a visual break between sections.

Visual separator between option groups or option sections.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Props** | None |
| **Slots** | None |
| **DOM** | `data-select-separator` |
| **ARIA** | `role="separator"`, `aria-orientation="horizontal"` |

## SelectTag

Chip for a selected value in multi-select mode.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Props** | `value`, `label` |
| **Slots** | `default`, `{ label, value }`, `remove`, `{ label, value }` |
| **DOM** | `data-select-tag`, `data-select-tag-remove` |

## SelectClear

Button to reset the selection.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Props** | None |
| **Slots** | `default` |
| **DOM** | `data-select-clear` |
| **ARIA** | `aria-label="Clear selection"` |

Visible when `clearable && hasValue && !disabled`.

## SelectIcon

Leading icon before the value display.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Props** | None |
| **Slots** | `default` |
| **DOM** | `data-select-icon` |
| **ARIA** | `aria-hidden="true"` |

## SelectTrailingIcon

Trailing dropdown icon for open/loading state.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Props** | None |
| **Slots** | `default`, `{ open, loading }` |
| **DOM** | `data-select-trailing-icon`, `data-open`, `data-loading` |
| **ARIA** | `aria-hidden="true"` |

## SelectCreateItem

Create action for custom values from the search query. Requires `create-item` on `SelectRoot`.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Props** | None |
| **Slots** | `default`, `{ searchValue }` |
| **DOM** | `data-select-create-item` |
| **ARIA** | `role="option"` |

## SelectNoOptions

Empty state when no options match the filter.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Props** | None |
| **Slots** | `default`, `{ searchValue }` |
| **DOM** | `data-select-no-options` |
| **ARIA** | `role="status"` |

## Assembled Select

Fixed composition of all primitives. See [Usage](/getting-started/usage), [Assembled Select deep dive](/guide/deep-dive), and [Props](/api/props#assembled-select).

| | |
|---|---|
| **Import** | `import Select from "vue3-select-component"` |
| **Slots** | `icon`, `trailing-icon`, `{ open, loading }`, `tag-remove`, `{ label, value }` (multi-select), `no-options`, `{ searchValue }`, `create-item`, `{ searchValue }`, `clear` |
| **Props** | Includes `clearable` to show the clear button |
| **DOM** | `data-assembled-select` on root |

**Default structure:**

```
SelectRoot
├── SelectTrigger
│   ├── SelectIcon
│   ├── SelectValue
│   ├── SelectInput
│   ├── SelectTrailingIcon
│   └── SelectClear
└── SelectPopover
    └── SelectListbox
        ├── SelectNoOptions
        ├── SelectGroup
        │   ├── SelectGroupLabel
        │   └── SelectOption (per option)
        ├── SelectSeparator
        ├── SelectOption (per option)
        └── SelectCreateItem (when create-item is enabled)
```

---

# Docus Default Starter

Source: https://github.com/totominc/vue3-select-component/blob/master/docs/README.md

# Docus Default Starter

> A beautiful, minimal starter for creating documentation with Docus

This is the default Docus starter template that provides everything you need to build beautiful documentation sites with Markdown and Vue components.

> [!TIP]
> If you're looking for i18n support, check out the [i18n starter](https://github.com/nuxt-themes/docus/tree/main/.starters/i18n).

## ✨ Features

- 🎨 **Beautiful Design** - Clean, modern documentation theme
- 📱 **Responsive** - Mobile-first responsive design
- 🌙 **Dark Mode** - Built-in dark/light mode support
- 🔍 **Search** - Full-text search functionality
- 📝 **Markdown Enhanced** - Extended markdown with custom components
- 🎨 **Customizable** - Easy theming and brand customization
- ⚡ **Fast** - Optimized for performance with Nuxt 4
- 🔧 **TypeScript** - Full TypeScript support

## 🚀 Quick Start

```bash
# Install dependencies
npm install

# Start development server
npm run dev
```

Your documentation site will be running at `http://localhost:3000`

## 📁 Project Structure

```
my-docs/
├── content/              # Your markdown content
│   ├── index.md         # Homepage
│   ├── 1.getting-started/  # Getting started section
│   └── 2.essentials/    # Essential documentation
├── public/              # Static assets
└── package.json         # Dependencies and scripts
```

## ⚡ Built with

This starter comes pre-configured with:

- [Nuxt 4](https://nuxt.com) - The web framework
- [Nuxt Content](https://content.nuxt.com/) - File-based CMS
- [Nuxt UI](https://ui.nuxt.com) - UI components
- [Nuxt Image](https://image.nuxt.com/) - Optimized images
- [Tailwind CSS 4](https://tailwindcss.com/) - Utility-first CSS
- [Docus Layer](https://www.npmjs.com/package/docus) - Documentation theme

## 📖 Documentation

For detailed documentation on customizing your Docus project, visit the [Docus Documentation](https://docus.dev)

### 🤖 AI Assistant Skill

Get started quickly with Docus by adding specialized knowledge to your AI assistant (Cursor, Claude, etc.):

```bash
npx skills add nuxt-content/docus
```

This skill helps you create documentation faster by providing your AI assistant with best practices, MDC component usage, ready-to-use templates, writing guidelines, and configuration tips for Docus. Perfect for quickly scaffolding new documentation projects.

## 🚀 Deployment

Build for production:

```bash
npm run build
```

The built files will be in the `.output` directory, ready for deployment to any hosting provider that supports Node.js.
